The University has 98 Degree Courses (30 indergraduate, 45 master’s degree, 23 PhD), 42 Courses Post Lauream, 12 Departments among these, for the Italian's law 7 were eligible as Excellent Departments and 4 were elected as Excellent Departments (Law, Engineering, Math and Phisics, Science). 

The Science Department, is an interdisciplinary Department in which many skills converge to develop different and multidisciplinary kind of researches. Whitin the Science Department there is a group of engineers drived by Professor Fabio Leccese that leads the Electric and Electronic Measurement Laboratory involved in many research activities and, specifically, since 2012, in aerospace researches. 
In particular, the Laboratory studies how the typical topic of the Measurement Science can support and can produce proactive information in the development of the Aerospace activities. In this general context, the research is particularly focused on the evaluation of the Resilience of autonomous complex systems (as Satellites, Extraterrestrial devices, etc.) searching to evaluate their Operational Availability of the devices and so their Autonomic Logistic. The Laboratory has all the competences to design, develop and build electronic devices even for aerospace field.

More than 30 scientific papers heve been produced in this field, even with the collaboration of SeTeL s.r.l..

In reference to this project, our Laboratory, in collaboration with Se.Te.L., developed an ELT/S according to COSPAR-SARSAT specification.

AQCLab Software Quality, although created as a company in 2019, is actually a spinoff of Intelligent Environments (previously registered with ESA), which was created in 2006. However, due to the specialization of AQCLab as the first internationally accredited laboratory for the evaluation of software product quality, in 2019 the management of IE decided to make it a company on its own and that is when AQCLab Software Quality was born. 

AQCLab is composed of highly qualified professionals (Engineers and PhDs in Computer Science) with experience in software and data quality, software development and maintenance methodologies, process and project management, governance and auditing, and business engineering. 

The company is committed to innovation, with continuous interaction with the university environment, as we consider research and innovation to be essential elements for the improvement and sustainability of information systems, having participated in more than 10 R+D+i projects in recent years.

AQCLab specializes in measuring, evaluating and improving the quality of software and data. As a result of this, AQCLab was accredited as the first and only laboratory at an international level that is accredited by ENAC (National Accreditation Entity) and ILAC for the evaluation of software product and data quality, following the good practices of the international standard ISO/IEC 25000.

Thanks to AQCLab's assessments, organizations can not only evaluate and improve the quality of their software and data, but also obtain a quality certification in ISO/IEC 25000, issued by a certification body such as AENOR.

Corsica Sardinia Elba Ferries – Step by Step…In 1968 Pascal P. Lota, from Bastia, founded the shipping company Corsica Line. The first ferry was the “Corsica Express”, capable of carrying 600 passengers and 60 vehicles.
From 1968 to 1981 the ferry company Corsica Ferries developed its main market: the passage between Italy and Corsica. 
The company grew and crossings to France were introduced. 
In 1973, the Company was renamed Corsica Ferries and became one of the world's largest shipping companies.
Step by step the Yellow Ships became a synonym for comfort and quality. 
1981: with the acquisition of the Italian company TTE, Sardinia Ferries joined Corsica Ferries. 
Now the company could also offer passages between Sardinia and Italy. The ship "Sardinia Nova" was the first yellow ferry to connect Livorno and Olbia. 
In 1996 the fast ferry (HSC) Corsica Express opened the route Nice-Corsica. The fast ferries made it possible to enter into the market of crossings between the French mainland and Corsica. Such a fast ferry was also used between Italy and Sardinia. 
In 2001 the Mega Express Class was introduced which made various new routes possible: between Toulon and the ports of Ajacco, Calvi, Ile Rousse and Bastia and between Livorno and Golfo Aranci (Sardinia). 
Today, the company has a fleet of 13 ships (8 Mega Express, 2 Cruise Ferries, 2 Day Ferries and 1 HSC Express) and operates services to Corsica and Sardinia all year round and to Elba and Balearic Islands, during the summer, and carrying more than 3.7 million passengers per year and over 1.2 million vehicles.

Organic Services is an international strategy and business consultancy for the food industry with particular focus on the organic sector. Drawing on more than 30 years of industry experience, we advise growers and grower groups, traders and certifiers as well as public and private organizations. Our mission: more sustainability and transparency throughout the food supply chain. Our services are interdisciplinary and tailored to the needs of our customers and project partners. We support clients in strategic business development and market studies, certification and accreditation systems and transfer knowledge by organizing conferences and study trips.
For more than 15 years Organic Services has been the global sales partner for Intact’s Platform ERP certification management solution, the international market leader.
Being experts in the field of integrity management solutions, we also offer three innovative software tools for various players along the supply chain:
· Check Integrity is a cloud platform that maps and links certification and transaction data along the supply chain. Based on the certified acreage, yield and transaction data, the system calculates a mass balance and shows in real time whether the quantities requested in a specific quality are actually (still) tradable. These plausibility checks reveal food fraud even before the product is sold on the market. By applying Check Integrity, farmer as well as companies can prove the integrity of their products towards their buyers, a great advantage in marketing. Check Integrity is a generic tool that can be used in all product chains. In the organic sector, the platform is known as Check Organic and prevents conventional products from entering the supply chain as fake high-quality organic products.
· Group Integrity is a tailor-made solution for the professional management of internal control systems of grower groups as well as of companies with contracted smallholders that produce for national or international markets. The online-based tool professionalizes data collection and processing. It prepares grower groups optimally for external audits and for the certification against private and public quality standards.
· Ecert Basic is the standard application of the Intact Platform ERP certification management for local and small certification bodies. Within a defined workflow, control and certification processes are well structured, and procedures such as deadline management are automated. The clear workflow increases transparency, continuity and comprehensiveness and allows for high quality standards.
The combination of the three systems Check Integrity/ Check Organic, Group Integrity and Ecert Basic considerably facilitates the collaboration between supply chain actors, for example between a farmer group and their external certification body. This creates synergies that can benefit the industry as a whole. The verification of product provenience underscores the integrity of supply chains in the market.

Saab Deutschland GmbH Product Unit EW (EWD) in Germany has been delivering solutions to the intelligence community and regulatory authorities worldwide for more than 40 years. We have developed our expertise specifically in the fields of radio signal measurement and analysis, SIGINT, ESM and Information Fusion.

We develop and deliver systems for radio surveillance, big data analysis and border surveillance. These include broadband signal acquisition, signal analysis, automatic detection and classification of radio signals, their demodulation, decoding and speech processing, direction finding and geo-location.

In summary, we focus on the following objectives:
- Radio signal analysis for all operational users for all dimensions
- Situational awareness and situation picture creation
- Border surveillance using technical means, including situation picture and sensor fusion
- Radio emission location, also in urban scenarios
- Fusion of data, different sensors (e.g. COMINT, ELINT, OSINT et al.)
- Detection of wrong / fake / missing transponder signals (AIS, ADS-B)
- Analysis of unidentified signals
- Monitoring of frequency spectra (ITU)
- Identification and geo-location of interference sources
